review: source extraction, syntax parsing, UI/control inventory, modular handler review and explicit new-binding comparison; not a claim that all old controls have been ported

controls.label: Submit Slot
controls.note: Manual Submit Slot needs a new-protocol launcher command and a native selected-slot guard. Automatic submission already exists.

controls.label: Go Login
controls.note: Go Login is routed to /login for the selected country.

controls.label: Start New App
controls.note: New App is available in the toolbar and Retry; the separate launcher button was removed at the earlier user request.

controls.label: Relogin
controls.note: Old logout/re-login semantics need a new native authentication lifecycle adapter.

controls.label: Change Proxy
controls.note: Validated proxies are supported through On Max Attempts; the separate bulk manual button is not connected to the new helper. Security verification never triggers proxy rotation.

controls.label: Change IP
controls.note: Old provider-specific Change IP command is not connected to the new helper. It must not be used to bypass security verification.

controls.label: Super Refresh
controls.note: Legacy refresh is MONGOOSE_SLOT_ACTION refresh. New-site SPA booking/liveness guards require adaptation before exposing it.

controls.label: Change Days
controls.note: Legacy change-day command; needs a native new-calendar adapter.

controls.label: Clear Days
controls.note: Legacy clear-days command; the new React calendar has different selection state.

controls.label: Submit Visatype
controls.note: The new site has no old VisaType page. Auto Book Appointment covers the pre-calendar native flow; old stop-toggle semantics are not identical.

controls.label: Submit Pre Slot
controls.note: Submit Pre Slot opens the current-country Retry route.

controls.label: Reload Session
controls.note: Requires stage-aware login navigation excluding calendar, verification and payment, which share SPA URLs.

controls.label: Auto Login
controls.note: Native login form filling, selected account persistence and successful SPA login-to-account regression tested.

controls.label: Auto Captcha
controls.note: The new portal keeps its native verification. The old numeric-image solver is not a replacement for new-site verification.

controls.label: Auto Visa Type
controls.note: Auto Book Appointment: native primary applicant / Individual flow. Family automation is not complete.

controls.label: Auto Submit Slot
controls.note: Auto Submit Calendar uses native available date, earliest time and one confirmation. Random/First/Last date modes.

controls.label: Auto Retry Calendar
controls.note: Auto Retry Calendar and configurable Delay; blank Delay holds.

controls.label: Auto Retry Calendar /Sec
controls.note: Delay in seconds covers interval retries; old separate Sec toggle is not exposed. Exact-second targeting is a separate pending feature.

controls.label: Auto Proxy Rotation
controls.note: Only the explicit On Max Attempts proxy action is implemented for the new helper.

controls.label: Auto Reload Error Occurred
controls.note: Calendar transient failures already back off. The separate old generic-page switch/delay has not been ported.

controls.label: Auto Reload Site Errors
controls.note: New Retry respects transient errors, 401/403 and 429. Broad page/POST automatic reloading is not ported.

controls.label: Minute Distribution
controls.note: The old minute-divider accepts Spain/Portugal and TORNADO_MINUTE messages; new channels need readiness, scheduling and cancel integration.

controls.label: Signal Submit - Calendrie
controls.note: New helper needs a native manual-submit command for the launcher signal.

controls.label: Signal Submit - Retry Calendrie
controls.note: Local manual Retry exists; the legacy bulk signal is not integrated.

controls.label: Signal Submit - Visatype
controls.note: No old VisaType route exists; equivalent action needs explicit new booking semantics.

controls.label: Signal Alert 🔔
controls.note: Legacy alert sound/notification requires a new available-slots notification adapter.

controls.label: Dark Mode Launcher
controls.note: The original launcher theme switch is now visible under Secondary for both new countries.

controls.label: Recaptcha Token
controls.note: Do not replay old tokens into the new verification system. New-site verification remains controlled by the website.
Old token refresh behavior does not map to a documented new-site action.

controls.label: Center
controls.note: Advanced Centre criterion, checked against the saved applicant; Mauritania only Nouadhibou. Applicant edits remain manual.

controls.label: Visa Type
controls.note: Advanced Visa Type criterion, checked against saved applicant.

controls.label: Category
controls.note: Removed at the earlier user request; appointment type/category remains a native calendar choice.

controls.label: Members
controls.note: Advanced member count is saved; automatic Individual uses one primary applicant. Family selection remains manual.

controls.label: Update
controls.note: Advanced Update saves scoped Centre/Visa Type/Members criteria.

controls.label: On Max Attempts :
controls.note: Stop/New App/Switch Proxy, once per reached limit, after server cooldown.

controls.label: Proxy From :
controls.note: Uses valid proxies supplied by Manage > Proxy. Separate old source selector is not migrated.

controls.label: Delay (seconds) :
controls.note: Delay seconds 1–120 or empty; empty disables automatic calendar requests.

controls.label: Attemps (value) :
controls.note: Attempt limit remains in Launcher; deliberately removed from Retry panel.

controls.label: Delay Reload Error Occurred (seconds) :
controls.note: Separate old Error Occurred delay is not connected to the new helper.

controls.label: Auto Refresh On Errors (seconds) :
controls.note: Separate old site error refresh delay is not connected to the new helper.
